description: Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc. is a global, all-domain defense partner, building and delivering the world's most powerful, survivable naval ships and technologies that safeguard America's seas, sky, land, space and cyber. For more than a century its Ingalls Shipbuilding segment in Mississippi and Newport News Shipbuilding segment in Virginia have built more ships in more ship classes than any other U.S. naval shipbuilder, making it America's largest shipbuilder, and its Mission Technologies segment develops integrated technology solutions and products that enable today's connected, all-domain force. Headquartered in Newport News, Virginia, it employs over 44,000 people domestically and internationally, and it conducts most of its business with the U.S. Government, primarily the Department of War, as prime contractor, principal subcontractor, team member or partner on many high-priority U.S. defense programs.
